Build kit for "AspectRatio - Image Gallery"

Start from the TEMPLATE, fill it with BLOCKS, and use COMPONENTS only for what is left.
Changing a page you already have? Keep it, and use only the blocks and components.

TEMPLATE
Search matched `centered-hero` by name, but this template fits more of the idea. Scaffold it, then replace its content. Keep its layout and spacing.

name:        classic-gallery
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Uniform grid of equal-ratio media tiles under a centered intro, with filter tabs that narrow the set in place.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template classic-gallery --type page <path>

OTHER TEMPLATES
If the layout is wrong, scaffold one of these instead. All page templates: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template --list --type page

name:        mixed-gallery
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Masonry grid of variable-height tiles that pack against each other instead of cropping to a shared ratio, captioned per tile.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template mixed-gallery --type page <path>

name:        gallery-hero
package:     @astryxdesign/core
description: Centered stack (headline, short blurb, call-to-action buttons) resolving into a multi-image photo grid rather than one wide full-bleed picture, so the imagery reads as a set.
command:     npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 template gallery-hero --type page <path>

Keyword search matched these page templates: centered-hero (@astryxdesign/core), gallery-hero (@astryxdesign/core), mixed-gallery (@astryxdesign/core).
